Sources

Primary Recipe Output

Craft a hydrilium log splitter

With each strike of the hammer, you infuse the hydrilium into the log splitter, transforming it into a tool of immense power. As the metal glows, you feel the energy of the earth coursing through your veins.

Fortify a tool with the power of hydrilium, capable of cleaving even the mightiest of logs with ease.
